evidence_quotes.O: I rarely used the manual settings other than Aperture Priority to get a blurred background. Intelligent Auto (iA) is normally where I leave the setting anyhow.

evidence_quotes.E: WOW! Fastest camera I've ever owned, not only on start-up, but SUPER fast shutter response, and fast recycling to take the next photo.

evidence_quotes.N: (I have taken some grainy photos while playing around with it, but they were my fault due to low light without the flash being up).
